parts.name: CheckboxGroup
parts.description: A `<div role="group">` around checkboxes that share one value: the list of the checked boxes' values. Inside a FieldRoot it is the field's control.

props.name: value
props.description: The values of the checked boxes. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the group. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over (`value={setting}`); one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The values checked at first, when the group isn't controlled. Those boxes carry the `checked` attribute, so a form reset checks them again.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new list when the user checks or clears a box, or presses the parent box, and once when a form reset changes an uncontrolled group. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the boxes are never held by it, and a box pressed while a save is out shows on top of the guess.

props.name: allValues
props.description: Every value a box in the group can have. Needed for a parent box, which checks all of them.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every box in the group natively.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the list differs from its initial one.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the group is disabled, by its own prop or by its Field or Fieldset.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while at least one box is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while focus is on one of the boxes.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once focus has been in the group and left it.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.
